entry.title: Package managers have an integrity problem
entry.summary:
I tested 25 of the most popular package managers to check whether they detect a compromised package repository injecting malicious code into legitimate packages. This code integrity problem could be solved using cryptographic hashes or signatures, but many package managers are still vulnerable to this threat. Of the 25 package managers reviewed 1 , fewer than half used lockfiles that checked for tampering by default, and only two verified the integrity of every package they downloaded.

Source: Trail of Bits Security Research · Tags: #infosec #cryptography #rust #databases

entry.title: Practical Keyword SPIR with Lightweight Clients: Hintless and Efficient
entry.summary:
Keyword private information retrieval (keyword PIR) enables a client to retrieve the value associated with a keyword without revealing the queried keyword, generalizing traditional index PIR. This work advances the state of the art of Hao et al. (USENIX Security 2025) by addressing several key limitations of their constructions, most notably the efficiency bottleneck of their generic framework and the over-revealing nature of their more efficient designs.

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #cryptography #zkp #databases #rag
